description:
Music for Dopamine Boost | Sitar & Bansuri for Positive Energy | 1.5 Hours

Feeling flat? This is a natural lift — no caffeine, no hype. Ninety minutes of bright, uplifting Indian classical fusion to boost your mood, clear your focus, and bring back a little positive energy.

What you'll hear: a warm, bright weave of bansuri (bamboo flute), sitar, and gentle tabla in Raga Bhupali — joyful and clean, like clean morning light filling a room. Uplifting but unhurried — positive energy without the jitter.

Best for: a positive reset · focus and flow at work or study · lifting a low mood · clean energy for the day · a bright background for anything that needs a little lift.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to lift your mood, boost positive energy, and find clear, calm focus.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting, ornate warm-gold floral border. BRIGHT daytime palette — luminous cream/gold, sunlit warmth, fresh open lake-and-palace landscape. Central figure: a serene, blissful musician playing bansuri, with a sitar visible in the foreground (shows the fusion) — joyful clarity and positive energy. Distinct from the channel's dusky evening/calm thumbnails (this is bright, warm, open). Overlay text 'LIFT YOUR MOOD' in dark-teal serif, large stacked, mobile-readable. Declarative positive (NOT a question). NOTE (post-launch learning): soft positive declarative under-pulled on impressions vs pain Q-hooks — consider Test & Compare with a stronger hook if reach stays soft.
suno_prompt_A: Uplifting Indian classical fusion, Raga Bhupali — joyful major pentatonic (Sa Re Ga Pa Dha), clean bright open character. Begins with a short gentle swell, the bright bansuri melody arriving within the first 4 seconds over a soft tanpura drone; a light tabla settles into a relaxed lilting teental groove and a warm plucked sitar answers in call-and-response with meend slides and gentle taan runs. Bansuri leads as the singing voice, sitar weaving warm accents, subtle santoor shimmer underneath. 432Hz, 66 BPM, mid register, warm radiant production with natural breath, even and steady throughout. The feeling of clean morning light filling a room and the mind waking up clear, positive and focused. Seamless loop-friendly, no vocals, no humming, no human voice.
suno_prompt_B: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming. Uplifting Indian classical fusion — bright bansuri-led with sitar and light tabla. Raga Bhupali, joyful major pentatonic (Sa Re Ga Pa Dha). Gentle quick intro, bright bansuri melody by 4s over soft tanpura, relaxed lilting tabla groove, warm sitar call-and-response with meend and taan, subtle santoor shimmer. 432Hz, 66 BPM, mid register, radiant airy production. Like clean morning light and a clear, positive, focused mind. Seamless loop.

production_spec.loop_seam: Suno extend 4-5x on the best take → loop in post to fill 90 min, crossfade boundaries
